name: usgs-streamgage-record-survival
description: When a new USGS daily mean streamflow record opens at a monitoring location, will that record still be active five years later?
split_description: Chronological by `begin` date: train 2001-01-01 to 2012-12-31; eval 2013-01-01 to 2015-12-31; holdout 2016-01-01 to 2019-12-31. A 60-day embargo gap is dropped immediately after each boundary (2013-01-01 to 2013-03-01 and 2016-01-01 to 2016-03-01) so multi-site installation projects do not straddle splits. Rows are distinct locations, so no location appears in more than one split and no row's outcome window is another row's input.
